# Saira, Sivy, and Simon's Birthday

> A joint birthday celebration invitation page. Guests can confirm attendance, receive an entrance ticket with QR code, and see who else is coming.

## About
- Event: Joint birthday celebration for Saira, Sivy, and Simon
- Date: October 31, 2026 at 1:00 PM
- Location: To be announced
- Admission: Free (by invitation)

## What This Site Does
- Allows invited guests to confirm their attendance
- Generates a unique entrance ticket with QR code
- Shows a live list of confirmed attendees
- Accepts optional birthday gifts via GCash/InstaPay

## Key Pages
- [Home / Login](https://sairasivybirthday.vercel.app/): Entry point for guests to sign in and confirm attendance
- [Attendance Confirmation](https://sairasivybirthday.vercel.app/#form): RSVP form with selfie and details
- [Who's Coming](https://sairasivybirthday.vercel.app/#attendees): List of confirmed guests

## Contact
- Host: Simon Jabeguero
- Site: https://sairasivybirthday.vercel.app/
